messages:
sophie: Quick pass on the 'First deploy' section today — aim to simplify the narrative, standardize env var names with the SDKs, and squash a couple of broken links. I have a draft PR (GH #4120) but want quick sync on scope.
kevin: which broken links did you find?
sophie: Two: the registry badge link to the model catalog (404) and the old 'deploy to cloud' marketplace link. Also one step where we tell users to set TOKEN instead of REDWOOD_API_KEY — that's inconsistent with our SDKs.
maria: I can update the SDK snippets (py/ts) to use REDWOOD_API_KEY and push the code examples. Any decision on naming conventions? REDWOOD_API_KEY vs RW_API_KEY?
sophie: prefer REDWOOD_API_KEY for clarity. mentioned in the Console UI as "API key" so full name is better for newcomers.
tyler: FYI CI for #4120 failed linting on the md frontmatter — will fix once you confirm snippet changes.
kevin: also noticed the quickstart instructs `curl` with `-H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` — we should show `export REDWOOD_API_KEY=...` then `-H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY"` so examples line up.
maria: adding both py and ts minimal examples. I'll include a short note about where to find keys in Console (Settings -> API keys) and a screenshot placeholder.
sophie: thanks. Also shorter copy for the first-paragraph blurb — current intro is a bit dense. Suggest: "Get a running Redwood inference in five minutes: create an API key, install the SDK, and run the example."
kevin: love it. For the screenshot placeholder use: `/assets/screenshots/console-apikey-2025.png` — we'll swap with final export later.
tyler: I pushed a small formatter fix on a branch; once maria updates snippets I can re-run the preview build.
docs-bot: CI build succeeded for branch fix/4120-snippet-updates (build 987). :white_check_mark:
kevin: one more nit — change the link text "see our model list" to be more descriptive like "model catalog (open models)" for accessibility.
sophie: good call. I'll update the PR description and add a checklist: 1) replace TOKEN with REDWOOD_API_KEY 2) update py/ts snippets 3) fix two broken links 4) shorten intro blurb 5) add screenshot placeholder 6) run preview build.
maria: I'll open a follow-up PR with the snippet changes and reference #4120 so we can land together. ETA EOD.
sophie: perfect — tagging reviewers @kevin and @tyler once both PRs exist. Thanks all. :sparkles:
